name: Aeon ★ Aha
desc: Cries and comedy intertwine, and the deathly still cosmos awakens to daybreak in a farce.\nStepping back onto the stage of the Path, I tear off the god's mask. Who is Aha? I am Aha!\nTo play, to trick, to hunt... Please bear witness to an improv tour where humans and gods dance as one!

1.name: Who Giggled at the Primordial Hush?
1.desc: When entering combat, immediately gain <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Wishpower," and <u>merrymakes</u> <u>Elation DMG</u> dealt by all ally targets by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

30000011.name: Merrymake
30000011.desc: A special effect that affects Elation DMG and can additionally boost Elation DMG dealt.

10015111.name: Path of Elation Ascension
10015111.desc: When Aeon ★ Aha has the "Faces of Elation" state, "Punchline" and "Certified Banger" are enhanced to "Bliss" and "Party Trick," and ally characters on the Path of Elation will activate their "Innate Trace" effects.

3.name: A Stacked Deck of Sorrow and Joy
3.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nElation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

4.name: A Joke's Fate Boxed in Black
4.desc: Increases the multiplier of the <u>True DMG</u> dealt by Elation Skills by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the original multiplier. When Aeon ★ Aha deals <u>Elation DMG</u>, an additional <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the cumulative "Certified Banger" stacks possessed by teammates will be taken into the account.

10000017.name: True DMG
10000017.desc: Non-Type DMG that is not affected by any effects. This DMG is not considered as launching 1 attack.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

5.name: Moi Onstage and Me Offstage
5.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nElation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

6.name: For THEY Said: You Are Elation
6.desc: Enemy targets always have the <u>"Elation Debt"</u> effect that is at least equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the target's Max HP. The first time Aeon ★ Aha casts the Ultimate, <u>Aha</u> immediately gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> that adds a fixed <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u> to the count. Each subsequent Ultimate cast <u>advances</u> the <u>Aha's</u> action by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.

10015114.name: Elation Debt
10015114.desc: Elation Debt occupies Max HP. If the occupied portion includes current HP, that portion of current HP is immediately lost.

10000026.name: Aha
10000026.desc: When taking action, triggers an Aha Instant and causes units capable of using Elation Skills to each use their Elation Skill 1 time. If there are no units capable of using Elation Skills when Aha takes action, Aha will use "Let There Be Laughter."\nThe Aha Instant lasts until the final Elation Skill finishes this time.\nWhen the Aha Instant ends, participating characters gain the "Certified Banger" state for the Punchline points taken into account this time, lasting for 2 turns. After Aha takes action, all Punchlines will be consumed.

10000027.name: Punchline
10000027.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

10000001.name: Action Advance
